description: Aggregate a list of source resources into a single buffer, failing fast on any problem, under boundary conditions: several local files aggregated in order, an empty resource list, a sequence where a valid local file precedes an insecure URL, and a sequence where a valid local file precedes a missing local file. The input carries the list of resources, whether a base directory is available, and the in-memory contents of any local files; the output is either the aggregated buffer or the normalized error.
